sn22.39:1.2: “Bhikkhus, when a bhikkhu is practising in accordance with the Dhamma, this is what accords with the Dhamma:
sn22.39:1.3: he should dwell engrossed in revulsion towards form, feeling, perception, volitional formations, and consciousness. One who dwells engrossed in revulsion towards form …
sn22.39:1.4: and consciousness, fully understands form, feeling, perception, volitional formations, and consciousness.
sn22.39:1.5: One who fully understands form … and consciousness is freed from form, feeling, perception, volitional formations, and consciousness.
sn22.39:1.6: He is freed from birth, aging, and death; freed from sorrow, lamentation, pain, displeasure, and despair; freed from suffering, I say.”
